description: Master Multi-Modal Sensor Integration, Time Synchronization, Spatial Geometry, and Environmental Telemetry Contract.

temporal_synchronization_budget.budget_rationale: Corresponds to 1.0 frame interval at 30 fps; guarantees control signal and visual observation map to identical temporal epoch within one discrete video frame.

spatial_geometry_contract.camera_intrinsics_model: BROWN_CONRADY_PINHOLE_RADIAL_TANGENTIAL (fx, fy, cx, cy, k1, k2, p1, p2, k3)
homography_sufficiency_criteria: Vehicle and pedestrian footfalls remain strictly in contact with flat concrete slab
No ramps, raised docks, or uneven floor depressions exceeding 20mm elevation
Sufficient for 2D footprint tracking, separation distances, and boundary crossing detection
three_dimensional_reconstruction_mandate: Required when pallet loads create 3D visual occlusions across cross-aisle sightlines
Required when forklift mast elevation lifts cargo into overhead camera FOV
Required when dynamic ray-casting against 3D warehouse racking geometry is used to compute line-of-sight visibility

zone_polygon_definitions.primary_interaction_zone: Planar 2D polygon enclosing central transit lane
zone_polygon_definitions.secondary_zone_entry: Planar 2D polygon bounding the aisle junction intersection
zone_polygon_definitions.secondary_zone_depth: 3D volumetric bounding box enclosing aisle space between racking uprights up to 6.0m height

lux_sensor.purpose: Continuously measure ambient light level at aisle ground plane to calibrate optical detector reliability and identify shadow degradation.
lux_sensor.mounting_location: Mounted at 2.5m height on rack column facing aisle floor

environmental_particulate_monitor.purpose: Monitor airborne dust concentration resulting from heavy braking or concrete wear that degrades camera and LiDAR optical fidelity.
